Use `rich.live.Live` to update a value in place; see the [Live Display docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst). Rich removes carriage returns from rendered text, so `rich.print()` does not use `\r` for cursor movement. Flushing writes buffered output but does not move the cursor. For help choosing an approach, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
